summary: The bill expands Medicare Part B coverage starting in 2027 to pay for genetic counseling services furnished by licensed or board-certified genetic counselors, at 85% of the physician fee schedule rate, while barring balance billing and allowing physicians to continue billing for such services.

scores.thoughts: The bill expands Medicare Part B coverage to include services provided by genetic counselors, which will increase federal outlays under the Medicare program. This directly expands government spending on healthcare services.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, or revenue measures.
The legislation amends the Social Security Act to add Medicare coverage for genetic counseling services furnished by genetic counselors, expanding access under the public Medicare program.
